description: This file defines the 'Group' data model and related functions for managing groups within the Mattermost platform, including validation, serialization, and associated types.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a group with properties such as ID, name, description, source, and member counts, along with validation and utility methods.

classes.name: GroupWithUserIds
classes.description: Extends Group to include a list of user IDs associated with the group.

classes.name: GroupWithSchemeAdmin
classes.description: Extends Group with a scheme admin flag indicating administrative privileges.

classes.name: GroupsAssociatedToChannelWithSchemeAdmin
classes.description: Associates a list of groups with a channel, including scheme admin info.

classes.name: GroupsAssociatedToChannel
classes.description: Represents groups associated with a specific channel.

classes.name: GroupPatch
classes.description: Structure for updating group properties such as name, display name, description, and reference allowance.

classes.name: GroupSearchOpts
classes.description: Options for searching groups with various filters and pagination.

classes.name: GetGroupOpts
classes.description: Options for retrieving group details, including member counts and IDs.

classes.name: GroupStats
classes.description: Contains statistics about a group's member count.

classes.name: GroupModifyMembers
classes.description: Structure for modifying group membership by user IDs.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of group properties for auditing purposes.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Returns a clone of the group data for logging.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of group with user IDs for auditing.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of group with scheme admin info for auditing.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update group properties.

methods.name: IsValidForCreate
methods.description: Validates the group data before creation.

methods.name: requiresRemoteId
methods.description: Checks if the group requires a remote ID based on its source.

methods.name: IsSyncable
methods.description: Determines if the group source is syncable.

methods.name: IsValidForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the group data before updating.

methods.name: IsValidName
methods.description: Validates the group's name according to rules.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the group's name or a safe dereferenced value.

methods.name: GetRemoteId
methods.description: Returns the group's remote ID or a safe dereferenced value.

methods.name: GetMemberCount
methods.description: Returns the group's member count or a safe dereferenced value.
